# level rank

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:levelRank`](gmeow-levelRank.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/levelRank>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ordinal rank of a [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) on the arousal ladder — a small integer ordering the rungs from high arousal ([`gmeow:levelHyperalert`](../individuals/gmeow-levelHyperalert.md), 5) down to none ([`gmeow:levelUnresponsive`](../individuals/gmeow-levelUnresponsive.md), 0). Used purely to ORDER the named levels; it asserts an ordinal sequence, not a metric scale (for a continuous value use [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:levelRank`](gmeow-levelRank.md) from [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) to [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to order the named [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) rungs — the integer a query reads to compare arousal between two named levels (higher rank = more alert).

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating the rank as a measured arousal magnitude or a confidence (use [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md) for a continuous value), and avoid asserting it on anything but a [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) individual.

### How to use

- Assign each [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) one [xsd:integer](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) in 0–5 reflecting its position on the ladder; read 'more alert than' as a rank comparison, leaving continuous arousal to [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md).

### Scope notes

- Ordering only, not a metric ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): [`gmeow:levelRank`](gmeow-levelRank.md) fixes the high→low sequence of the six named rungs so a query can compare 'more alert than'; it does not claim equal spacing or a measurement unit. The continuous metric companion is [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md).
